75366:
**Weaknesses:** 
- **Beagle Boys:** Stun, Zantetsuken
- **Peg Leg Pete:** Blind, Slow, Poison, Fire

The fight starts off with your second encounter with the Beagle Boys. It will go much like the first; they will group together to charge and slam into Sora. This time, however, you'll need to finish off each Beagle Boy with a Reality Shift attack.

After defeating the three Beagle Boys for the last time, Peg Leg Pete will join the fight. Pete has two main fighting tactics: melee attacks with his sword, and retreating to the side of the stage for a ranged attack. Just like the Beagle Boys, you have to finish off Pete with a Reality Shift attack.
